entry.title: Dub Station 1.0.2
entry.summary: Builds on 1.0.1 (fixed-wrapper rebuild — Q-Links on the track automation screen). Adds a visible PANIC button: each tap blinks amber for ~300 ms and clears itself (engine-driven, reliable on repeated/double taps), and still flushes the delay/reverb tails. No sound changes.

entry.title: Dub Station 1.0.1
entry.summary: Rebuilt on the fixed mpc-vst-plugins wrapper: physical Q-Links now move plugin parameters on the track **automation** screen (previously they snapped back). No sound or feature changes. - Upstream wrapper fix (sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins #486–489): a plain parameter write no longer forces an `audioMasterUpdateDisplay`. - Ships `params.lock` and a redrawn PANIC button with a clearly lit armed state. Verified on an MPC One (automation Q-Links fixed on-device).

entry.title: Dub Station 1.0.0
entry.summary: **Your one-stop effect plugin for dub techno. Not a clone, every bit its own.** First stable release. A native VST2 insert effect for standalone Akai MPC / Force (MPC OS 3.x): dual independent tape delay (resonant DJ-filter on A, tilt-filter + flanger on B), a huge modulated reverb (Airwindows Galactic), tape drive/warble/degrade, a filtered noise + crackle ambience bed, a phaser, ducking, a global mix and a **Panic** kill. Space-Echo-inspired touchscreen skin, three pages, full Q-Links. ### Cha
